definition: The probability that the market is in its event state, from a hidden Markov model with states fitted to the log returns of the last window prices.
boundaries: Not computed in QML yet: it is fitted to history by numerical optimisation, which belongs in the Lab's training placement; it runs in shadow in the MIS until his yes, behind the same reading shape, so no unit changes when it goes live. It flips falsely more often than a penalised jump model, and a refit relabels the past, so stamped history comes first. Pooled by class or underlying, never one model per market.
recognition: A rising event probability marks a turbulent stretch.

class_meanings.index_cfd: A return across a session close, a weekend or a contract roll is a gap, not a bar's move; bind the statistic to bars inside one session or a back-adjusted series, or it reads the gap.
